program:

h2_2 = leftmost(!is_bos@j & !is_a@j & is_b@j | !is_a@i & is_b@i & !is_c@i & h1_1@i & h1_2@i, !is_c@i | !is_c@j)
h3_1 = rightmost(is_bos@i & is_a@i & !is_b@i & h1_1@i & !h1_2@i & h2_1@i & !h2_2@i & is_bos@j & is_a@j & !h1_1@j & !h1_2@j & h2_2@j | !is_b@i & h1_1@i & !h2_2@i & is_bos@j & is_a@j & is_b@j & is_c@j & !h1_1@j & !h1_2@j & h2_1@j & h2_2@j, is_a@i & !is_b@i & !is_c@i & h1_1@i & !h1_2@i & h2_1@i & h2_2@i & is_bos@j & is_a@j & !is_b@j & h1_1@j & !h1_2@j & h2_1@j & h2_2@j | is_bos@i & is_a@i & !h1_2@i & !h2_2@i & is_bos@j & !is_b@j & !is_c@j & !h1_1@j & !h1_2@j & h2_2@j)
h3_2 = leftmost(is_a@i & !is_b@i & !h1_1@i & !h1_2@i & !h2_2@i & !is_bos@j & is_c@j & !h1_2@j & !h2_2@j | !is_b@i & !is_bos@j & !h1_1@j, !is_b@i & !is_bos@j & !is_b@j & !h1_1@j & !h1_2@j & !h2_2@j)
h4_2 = leftmost(is_bos@i & is_b@i & is_c@i & !h1_1@i & !h2_2@i & is_bos@j & !is_a@j & is_b@j & is_c@j & !h1_1@j & h1_2@j | !is_b@i & !is_c@i & h1_1@i & !h2_2@i & is_c@j & !h1_2@j & h2_2@j & h3_2@j, is_b@i & !h1_1@i & !h1_2@i & h3_1@i & h3_2@i & is_bos@j & !h1_2@j & h2_1@j | is_bos@i & !is_b@i & is_c@i & h1_1@i & h2_1@i & !h2_2@i & h3_1@i & h3_2@i & !is_bos@j & h2_2@j)
h5_1 = rightmost(h1_1@i & h2_2@i & !h3_2@i & !h3_2@j | h1_2@i & !h3_2@i & !is_bos@j & !h3_2@j, !h3_2@i & !is_bos@j | h1_2@i & !h3_2@i)
h6_1 = rightmost(!is_b@i & !h1_1@i & !h1_2@i & !h2_2@i & !h5_1@i & !is_b@j & !h1_1@j & !h1_2@j & !h2_2@j & !h5_1@j | !is_b@i & !h5_1@i & !is_b@j & !h1_1@j & !h1_2@j & !h2_2@j & !h5_1@j, !is_b@i & !h5_1@i & !is_b@j)
h6_2 = leftmost(!is_b@i & !h2_1@i & h3_2@i & !h5_1@i & !is_bos@j & !h1_1@j & !h1_2@j | !h1_1@i & !h1_2@i & !h2_2@i & !h5_1@i & !h1_1@j & !h1_2@j, !is_bos@i & !is_b@j & !h1_1@j & !h1_2@j & !h2_2@j | !is_b@j & !h1_1@j & !h1_2@j & !h2_2@j & !h5_1@j)
h8_1 = rightmost(!h5_1@i & !is_b@j & !h1_1@j & !h1_2@j & !h2_2@j | !h2_2@i & !h3_1@i & !h5_1@i & !is_b@j & !h1_1@j & !h1_2@j & !h2_2@j & !h5_1@j, !h1_1@i & !h5_1@i & !is_b@j & !h1_1@j & !h2_2@j | !h5_1@i & !is_b@j)
accept = !is_bos & !h3_2 & !h4_2 & !h6_1 & !h6_2 & !h8_1 | h1_1 & h1_2 & !h2_1 & !h3_1 & !h3_2 & !h6_1 & !h6_2 & !h8_1

output accept
